description: Override how one campaign sounds and who it is (admin only). Customs: tone, opening (said as the first line; {name} and {team} fill in), closing, say, never_say, customs, knock_line. Identity, for a campaign that calls as a different company: spoken_name, pronunciation, about, website, caller_name. Handoff: closer_name and handoff_number, the person and phone that ring when a live prospect wants a human on this campaign's calls (instead of the workspace's human line). Null returns a key to the team default.
name: set_campaign_customs
title: Customs for one campaign
